title: Project: CLI Task Manager
summary: Build a persistent command-line task manager: a validated model, an atomic JSON store and a command dispatcher.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: validation, ordering, identity and persistence.

rubric.label: Design
rubric.description: The model, the store and the command layer stay separable; the CLI contains no persistence logic and the store contains no formatting.
